summary_en: Interim dividend per share raised to ¥11.00 from ¥10.00 forecast. Full-year dividend forecast for FY2027 revised to ¥22.00 per share from ¥20.00, with interim at ¥11.00 and year-end forecast at ¥11.00. DOE remains primary metric for progressive dividend policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend of Surplus (Interim Dividend with Increase) and Revision to Year-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
UNIVANCE CORPORATION announced on November 13, 2026, a revision to its dividend policy for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim dividend per share was increased to ¥11.00 from the previously forecast ¥10.00, payable as of December 9, 2026, with a record date of September 30, 2026. The interim dividend represents an increase from ¥8.00 paid in the prior fiscal year.

The company simultaneously revised its full-year dividend forecast for FY2027 to ¥22.00 per share, up from the prior forecast of ¥20.00. The revision comprises an interim dividend of ¥11.00 and a projected year-end dividend of ¥11.00. This compares to the prior fiscal year's total dividend of ¥18.00 (¥8.00 interim plus ¥10.00 year-end).

The company's dividend policy is guided by DOE as a key metric. The revision reflects management's assessment of current business performance, financial condition, and commitment to enhancing shareholder value while maintaining balance between dividends and strengthening operational and financial foundations.
